goal: FG-312: hazard hints are few, distinct and closable

components.summary: Provides reusable state invariants, trace contracts and scenario packs.
responsibilities: provide reusable invariants and contracts; derive informational hazards from actual model structure and names, anchored to its nodes or edges, without usage-text predictions or verdict changes
check that handoffs between child models close
close a hazard hint that a known-bad variant or invariant covers

components.summary: Runs model proofs, precise placeholder failures, individual bound-test reach and native architecture rules with ordinary result messages.
responsibilities: run models and their known-bad and conformance checks; warn about every invariant that no known-bad variant violates; load sibling model imports from the model directory; derive component model hints from the contract-model tree; release fails on them; check a child's start states only when it declares project_parent_state, without lending parent-check calls to child anchors; report the actual design invariant and known-bad variant names without rerunning proof hooks, abbreviating only their text display; run models on the current tree with the target applied in one temporary model namespace with canonical filenames, selected sibling sources and finally restoration; keep default proof judgments and tag actual code gaps for target classification; print computed hazards for every model after its existing design exploration, never gating a verdict or repeating user hooks

fail a contract model whose IMPLEMENTED_BY anchors are missing, unresolved or never consulted (called or read); give conformance a static code-facts reader (anchors, words, imports of or references to a symbol outside its own file) and load the code an anchor names
own bounded subprocess cleanup shared by models and pytest shards; nested POSIX helpers share one session

run the built-in root model 'system' using the shared static architecture rules and known-bad generator from map analysis, with map check as conformance; reject shared state or side-effect ownership through that same architecture rule owner

run each model's TESTED_BY tests under the anchor watch; each bound test and parameter case must pass and call or explicitly read at least one implementation anchor in its own call window; name the rules that no bound test guards; run explicitly selected bound parameter items without weakening per-item code reach
check real code facts and keep failed facts visible; place models of unbuilt behavior in the target
return optional per-test statuses from the existing bound-test execution and report exact placeholder anchor failures without a traceback
print at most three open hazard hints per model
side_effects: runs one isolated pytest process per model when bound-test checking is requested
